project.name: Vidocq :: MicroProfile Extensions :: Rest Client (Cyrano) :: Codegen Bundle
project.description:
Companion codegen bundle for vidocq-runtime-cyrano-rest-client-extension. Declare this artifact in <annotationProcessorPaths> whenever the application depends on the Rest Client extension; Maven resolves the transitive APT dependencies below automatically.
- cyrano-cdi-vauban: runs Cyrano's Build Compatible Extension inside the Vauban processor, so the @RestClient bean of each @RegisterRestClient interface exists when the processor validates the deployment and is recorded for the runtime. Without it, @Inject @RestClient fails: the runtime does not run extensions over an application the processor already handled (unsatisfied dependency). - cyrano-processor: generates each client's proxy at compile time, so the application needs no `opens` to io.vidocq.cyrano.core (without it, Cyrano defines the proxy at run time, in the interface's package).
